name: Rhône Week
blurb: Peppery Syrah in the north, generous Grenache blends in the south.
placeTip: Ask a wine bar for a Côtes du Rhône by the glass.

name: Bubbles Week
blurb: Champagne, Cava, Crémant and beyond. Sparkling wine isn't just for celebrations.
placeTip: Ask your wine shop for a Crémant: Champagne method, friendlier price.

name: Italian Reds Week
blurb: Sangiovese, Nebbiolo and the food-loving acidity that makes Italian reds sing.
placeTip: Order a Chianti Classico with pasta at your local trattoria.

name: Riesling Week
blurb: Bone dry to lusciously sweet, always electric with acidity.
placeTip: Pair an off-dry Riesling with Thai or Indian takeout.

name: Pinot Noir Week
blurb: The heartbreak grape: light, silky and maddeningly expressive of place.
placeTip: Compare an Oregon and a Burgundy Pinot at a wine bar flight.

name: Spain Week
blurb: Tempranillo from Rioja and Ribera, plus great-value Garnacha.
placeTip: Find a tapas bar and order a Rioja Crianza.

name: Andes Week
blurb: High-altitude Malbec from Argentina and bright reds from Chile.
placeTip: Grill something and open a Mendoza Malbec.

name: Sauvignon Blanc Week
blurb: Zesty, herbal and grassy, from Sancerre to Marlborough.
placeTip: Order Sancerre with goat cheese or oysters.
